# Where to Watch GIMME SHELTER


by Angel | October 29, 2026


After years of abuse and foster care, pregnant teenager Agnes “Apple” Bailey runs away from her mother with nowhere to go. She searches for her estranged father, hoping to find someone who will take her in, but instead finds herself alone and without the support she needs.


Then she discovers an unexpected refuge: a shelter for pregnant teens where a group of young women begins to feel like family.


[Watch Gimme Shelter now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/gimme-shelter)


### **A Teenager With Nowhere to Turn**


Apple has spent much of her life moving from one difficult situation to another. When she becomes pregnant, she decides to leave home and try to build a life of her own.


But freedom comes with a harsh reality: she has nowhere to live and no reliable support system.


Her search for her estranged father doesn’t go as she hopes, leaving Apple to face an uncertain future on her own. With the help of a priest, she eventually finds her way to a shelter for pregnant teens.


For the first time, she encounters people who understand what she’s going through—and who are willing to stand beside her.


### **Finding Family in an Unexpected Place**


The shelter becomes more than a roof over Apple’s head.


Surrounded by young women facing difficult circumstances of their own, she begins forming friendships and discovering what it means to have people in her corner. The women at the shelter don’t have easy answers, but they offer something Apple desperately needs: a community that refuses to give up on her.


Her journey isn’t simple, and the film doesn’t pretend that rebuilding a life happens overnight. Instead, *Gimme Shelter* follows the small steps that help Apple begin imagining a different future.


### **Vanessa Hudgens Takes on a Powerful Role**


Vanessa Hudgens stars as Apple in a performance that takes her far beyond the roles audiences may have known her for.


The film places Apple’s fear, anger, vulnerability, and determination at the center of the story, giving Hudgens an opportunity to portray a young woman fighting to take control of her own life.


Viewers have praised the performance for its authenticity and emotional intensity. One IMDb reviewer wrote that you can “really feel what the main character is going through,” while another called it “one of Vanessa Hudgens’ best performances.”


### **Inspired by a Real Shelter**


*Gimme Shelter* was inspired by the real-life community behind a shelter for pregnant women and teens. That foundation gives the story another layer of meaning, connecting Apple’s fictional journey to the experiences of women who have faced similar circumstances.


The film ultimately asks viewers to look beyond someone’s circumstances and see the person underneath them—their potential, their pain, and their capacity for change.


As one viewer put it, the film is “a well told and produced” story about hope, family, society, and reality that makes you “feel, think and understand all parts and sides of life.”


### **Watch** ***Gimme Shelter*** **on Angel**


*Gimme Shelter* is a raw and emotional story about a young woman who has every reason to feel alone—and the people who help her discover that she doesn’t have to be.


Through Apple’s journey, the film explores survival, compassion, found family, and the possibility of a new beginning.
